naam: Arm voorwaarts laten zakken – met stok (excentrisch)
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left. She holds a straight stick horizontally with BOTH hands, shoulder-width apart, and both arms are raised straight forward and up so the stick is above her head. The arrow is a long curved arrow starting at her right hand and going forward and DOWN in a big arc to beside her right thigh, showing the right arm being lowered slowly forward and down.
eind_en: END position: her right arm has been lowered forward and down and now hangs straight beside her body; her left hand alone still holds the stick raised above her head. Both figures seen from the side, facing left.

naam: Arm zijwaarts laten zakken – met stok (excentrisch)
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT. Her right arm is straight and raised SIDEWAYS (out to her right side) to above shoulder height, the right hand holding one end of a straight stick; her left hand holds the other end of the stick low in front of her left hip, so the stick runs diagonally across her body and supports the right arm. The arrow is a long curved arrow from the right hand going sideways DOWN in an arc to beside her right thigh, showing the right arm being lowered slowly sideways.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, her right arm has been lowered sideways and now hangs straight beside her body (no longer holding the stick); her left hand holds the stick hanging down beside her left leg.

naam: Schouder naar binnen draaien in 90 graden – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from her right side, facing left. Behind her an elastic exercise band is tied to a door handle-height anchor at shoulder height. Her right upper arm is raised SIDEWAYS to shoulder height (upper arm horizontal, pointing out to her right toward the viewer), the right elbow bent 90 degrees and the forearm pointing straight UP toward the ceiling, the right hand holding the band which runs backward to the anchor behind her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the forearm rotating forward until it is horizontal.
eind_en: END position: the right upper arm stays at shoulder height out to the side, elbow still bent 90 degrees, but the forearm has rotated FORWARD and down and now points straight FORWARD (horizontal, parallel to the floor), stretching the band behind her.
extra_avatar: Seen from a three-quarter front view. In BOTH figures the right upper arm is horizontal, out to the SIDE at shoulder height, and the right ELBOW IS BENT 90 DEGREES (an L-shape) - the arm is NEVER straight. TOP: forearm points straight UP, hand beside the head. BOTTOM: the forearm has rotated forward and points straight FORWARD toward the viewer-side, horizontal; the elbow is still bent 90 degrees and still at shoulder height out to the side. The band runs from the hand to an anchor BEHIND her.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien in 90 graden – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from her right side, facing left. In FRONT of her an elastic exercise band is tied to an anchor at chest height. Her right upper arm is raised SIDEWAYS to shoulder height (upper arm horizontal, pointing out to her right toward the viewer), the right elbow bent 90 degrees and the forearm pointing straight FORWARD (horizontal), the right hand holding the band which runs forward to the anchor in front of her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going UP and BACK, showing the forearm rotating upward until it points to the ceiling.
eind_en: END position: the right upper arm stays at shoulder height out to the side, elbow still bent 90 degrees, but the forearm has rotated UPWARD and now points straight UP to the ceiling, hand beside her head, stretching the band in front of her.
extra_avatar: Seen from a three-quarter front view. In BOTH figures the right upper arm is horizontal, out to the SIDE at shoulder height, and the right ELBOW IS BENT 90 DEGREES (an L-shape) - the arm is NEVER straight. TOP: the forearm points straight FORWARD, horizontal, at shoulder height. BOTTOM: the forearm has rotated upward and points straight UP, hand beside the head. The band runs from the hand to an anchor IN FRONT of her.

naam: Schouderbladen naar achteren – buiklig met armen heffen
pose_en: She lies FACE DOWN (prone) on an exercise mat on the floor, seen from the side, head to the left, forehead resting on a small rolled towel, legs straight. Both arms lie straight alongside her body with the palms facing down. Her shoulders are relaxed. The arrow is a short curved arrow above her right hand pointing UP, showing the arms lifting a few centimetres off the mat.
eind_en: END position: still lying face down with the forehead on the towel and the legs on the mat, she squeezes her shoulder blades together and down and lifts BOTH straight arms a few centimetres off the mat alongside her body, palms facing down. Head stays down.
extra_avatar: Both figures lie face down on a mat, stacked. TOP: both arms rest flat ON the mat beside the body, relaxed. BOTTOM: both straight arms are clearly LIFTED about 10 cm OFF the mat (a visible gap under the arms and hands), shoulder blades squeezed together; head stays on the towel, legs stay down.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left, arms hanging relaxed beside her body, the shoulders slightly rounded forward. The arrow is a short curved arrow at her right shoulder pointing BACKWARD and slightly DOWN, showing the shoulder blade being drawn back and down.
eind_en: END position: she stands tall with her shoulders drawn back and down, chest slightly open, shoulder blades pulled together, arms still relaxed beside her body; the shoulders do not lift.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side, facing left. TOP: a clearly SLUMPED posture - shoulders rounded far forward, upper back rounded. BOTTOM: an upright posture with the shoulders clearly pulled BACK and DOWN, chest open and lifted. Make the difference between the two figures obvious.
